source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

verses.rationale: Keeps author, apostolic role, alien identity and all five regions.
verses.before: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect exiles of the dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.after: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen temporary residents of the dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia,
verses.tsw_comparator: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect exiles of the dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

verses.rationale: Preserves triune structure, blood imagery and increased blessing.
verses.before: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in the sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience to Jesus Christ and for sprinkling with his blood: May grace and peace be multiplied to you.
verses.after: chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, by the Spirit's sanctifying work, for obedience and sprinkling with Jesus Christ's blood: May grace and peace be multiplied to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in the sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience to Jesus Christ and for sprinkling with his blood: May grace and peace be multiplied to you.

verses.rationale: Keeps blessing, rebirth, living hope and resurrection.
verses.before: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! According to his great mercy, he has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.after: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he gave us new birth into a living hope through Jesus Christ's resurrection from the dead,
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! According to his great mercy, he has caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

verses.rationale: Retains three negatives and guarded inheritance.
verses.before: to an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, kept in heaven for you,
verses.after: into an inheritance that cannot decay, be defiled or fade, kept in heaven for you,
verses.tsw_comparator: to an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, kept in heaven for you,

verses.rationale: Keeps divine guarding, faith's means and future disclosure.
verses.before: who by God’s power are being guarded through trust for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.after: who are being guarded by God's power through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.tsw_comparator: who by God’s power are being guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

verses.rationale: Preserves joy and grief together and does not dismiss the suffering.
verses.before: In this you rejoice, though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been grieved by various trials,
verses.after: You rejoice in this, though for a little while now, if necessary, you have been grieved by various trials,
verses.tsw_comparator: In this you rejoice, though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been grieved by various trials,

verses.rationale: Keeps refining comparison, all three results and future revelation.
verses.before: so that the tested genuineness of your trust—more precious than gold that perishes though it is tested by fire—may be found to result in praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.after: so that the tested genuineness of your faith—more precious than perishable gold tested by fire—may result in praise, glory and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that the tested genuineness of your faith—more precious than gold that perishes though it is tested by fire—may be found to result in praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Retains doubled sight contrast and intensified joy.
verses.before: Though you have not seen him, you love him. Though you do not now see him, you believe in him and rejoice with joy that is inexpressible and filled with glory,
verses.after: Though you have not seen him, you love him. Though you do not see him now, you believe in him and rejoice with indescribable and glorious joy,
verses.tsw_comparator: Though you have not seen him, you love him. Though you do not now see him, you believe in him and rejoice with joy that is inexpressible and filled with glory,

verses.rationale: Renders souls as lives while keeping salvation as faith's end.
verses.before: obtaining the outcome of your trust, the salvation of your souls.
verses.after: receiving the outcome of your faith: the salvation of your lives.
verses.tsw_comparator: obtaining the outcome of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

verses.rationale: Keeps prophetic effort and grace's audience.
verses.before: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who prophesied about the grace that was to be yours searched and inquired carefully,
verses.after: The prophets who prophesied about the grace that would come to you searched and investigated this salvation carefully.
verses.tsw_comparator: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who prophesied about the grace that was to be yours searched and inquired carefully,

verses.rationale: Retains uncertainty of timing/person, Spirit and suffering/glory sequence.
verses.before: inquiring what person or time the Spirit of Christ in them was indicating when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the subsequent glories.
verses.after: They investigated what person or time the Spirit of Christ within them was indicating when he testified beforehand about Christ's sufferings and the glories to follow.
verses.tsw_comparator: inquiring what person or time the Spirit of Christ in them was indicating when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the subsequent glories.

verses.rationale: Keeps prophetic service, Spirit-sent proclamation and angelic desire.
verses.before: It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you, in the things that have now been announced to you through people who preached the good news to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things into which angels long to look.
verses.after: It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you in the things now announced to you through those who brought you the good news by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things angels long to look into.
verses.tsw_comparator: It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you, in the things that have now been announced to you through those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things into which angels long to look.

verses.rationale: Retains ancient clothing image, sobriety and future grace.
verses.before: So, preparing your minds for action and being sober-minded, set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.after: Therefore, with the loins of your mind girded and fully sober, set your hope completely on the grace being brought to you when Jesus Christ is revealed.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore, preparing your minds for action and being sober-minded, set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Keeps family identity and former molding.
verses.before: As obedient children, do not be conformed to the passions of your former ignorance,
verses.after: As obedient children, do not be shaped by the desires you formerly had in your ignorance.
verses.tsw_comparator: As obedient children, do not be conformed to the passions of your former ignorance,

verses.rationale: Preserves divine pattern and comprehensive life.
verses.before: but as he who called you is holy, you also be holy in all your conduct,
verses.after: Instead, just as the one who called you is holy, be holy yourselves in all your conduct,
verses.tsw_comparator: but as he who called you is holy, you also be holy in all your conduct,

verses.rationale: Keeps scriptural command and reason.
verses.before: since it is written, “You will be holy, for I am holy.”
verses.after: for it is written, “You will be holy, because I am holy.”
verses.tsw_comparator: since it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”

verses.rationale: Retains Father/judge tension, individual deeds and alien status.
verses.before: And if you call on him as Father who judges impartially according to each person’s deeds, conduct yourselves with fear throughout the time of your exile,
verses.after: If you call on as Father the one who judges each person's work impartially, live with reverent fear during the time of your temporary residence.
verses.tsw_comparator: And if you call on him as Father who judges impartially according to each one’s deeds, conduct yourselves with fear throughout the time of your exile,

verses.rationale: Keeps inherited conduct, ransom and precious-metal contrast.
verses.before: knowing that you were ransomed from the futile ways inherited from your forefathers, not with perishable things such as silver or gold,
verses.after: You know that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down by your ancestors, not with perishable things such as silver or gold,
verses.tsw_comparator: knowing that you were ransomed from the futile ways inherited from your forefathers, not with perishable things such as silver or gold,

verses.rationale: Retains blood, value and sacrificial animal comparison.
verses.before: but with the precious blood of Christ, like that of a lamb without blemish or spot.
verses.after: but with Christ's precious blood, like that of an unblemished and spotless lamb.
verses.tsw_comparator: but with the precious blood of Christ, like that of a lamb without blemish or spot.

verses.rationale: Keeps pretemporal knowledge and late manifestation.
verses.before: He was foreknown before the foundation of the world but was made manifest in the last times for your sake,
verses.after: He was known beforehand before the world's foundation but revealed at the end of the times for your sake.
verses.tsw_comparator: He was foreknown before the foundation of the world but was made manifest in the last times for your sake,

verses.rationale: Preserves mediation, resurrection, glory and divine-directed trust.
verses.before: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your trust and hope are in God.
verses.after: Through him you believe in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.
verses.tsw_comparator: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.

verses.rationale: Keeps purification, sibling love and intensity.
verses.before: Having purified your souls by obedience to the truth for a sincere brotherly love, love one another earnestly from a pure heart,
verses.after: Since you have purified your lives by obedience to the truth for sincere family love, love one another earnestly from the heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: Having purified your souls by obedience to the truth for a sincere brotherly love, love one another earnestly from a pure heart,

verses.rationale: Retains seed, rebirth and word's permanence.
verses.before: since you have been born again, not of perishable seed but of imperishable, through the living and abiding word of God;
verses.after: You have been born anew, not from perishable seed but imperishable, through God's living and enduring word.
verses.tsw_comparator: since you have been born again, not of perishable seed but of imperishable, through the living and abiding word of God;

verses.rationale: Keeps flesh/grass and glory/flower similes.
verses.before: for “All flesh is like grass and all its glory like the flower of grass. The grass withers, and the flower falls,
verses.after: For “all flesh is like grass, and all its glory like a grass flower. The grass withers and the flower falls,
verses.tsw_comparator: for “All flesh is like grass and all its glory like the flower of grass. The grass withers, and the flower falls,

verses.rationale: Preserves quotation's contrast and identifies the preached word.
verses.before: but the word of the Lord remains forever.” And this word is the good news that was preached to you.
verses.after: but the Lord's word endures forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you as good news.
verses.tsw_comparator: but the word of the Lord remains forever.” And this word is the good news that was preached to you.

verses.rationale: Keeps clothing-removal image and full vice list.
verses.before: So put away all malice and all deceit and hypocrisy and envy and all slander.
verses.after: Therefore, put away all malice, all deceit, hypocrisy, envy and every kind of slander.
verses.tsw_comparator: So put away all malice and all deceit and hypocrisy and envy and all slander.

verses.rationale: Retains infant/milk image and growth's goal.
verses.before: Like newborn infants, long for the pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow into salvation—
verses.after: Like newborn babies, long for pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow into salvation,
verses.tsw_comparator: Like newborn infants, long for the pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow into salvation—

verses.rationale: Keeps taste metaphor and conditional force.
verses.before: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good.
verses.after: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good.
verses.tsw_comparator: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is good.

verses.rationale: Preserves paradoxical living stone and human/divine evaluations.
verses.before: As you come to him, a living stone rejected by men but chosen and precious in the sight of God,
verses.after: As you come to him, a living stone rejected by people but chosen and honored by God,
verses.tsw_comparator: As you come to him, a living stone rejected by men but chosen and precious in the sight of God,

verses.rationale: Keeps building, priestly and sacrificial images.
verses.before: you yourselves, like living stones, are being built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.after: you yourselves, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: you yourselves, like living stones, are being built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Retains Zion, cornerstone and emphatic promise.
verses.before: For it stands in Scripture: “Behold, I am laying in Zion a stone, a cornerstone chosen and precious, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame.”
verses.after: For Scripture contains this: “Look, I lay in Zion a chosen and honored cornerstone, and the one who believes in him will never be put to shame.”
verses.tsw_comparator: For it stands in Scripture: “Behold, I am laying in Zion a stone, a cornerstone chosen and precious, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame.”

verses.rationale: Keeps honor and rejection reversal.
verses.before: So the honor is for you who believe, but for people who do not believe, “The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
verses.after: So honor belongs to you who believe. But for those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
verses.tsw_comparator: So the honor is for you who believe, but for those who do not believe, “The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”

verses.rationale: Preserves both stone images, disobedience and difficult appointment claim.
verses.before: and “A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word, as they were destined to do.
verses.after: and, “a stone that makes people stumble and a rock that makes them fall.” They stumble because they disobey the word, to which they were also appointed.
verses.tsw_comparator: and “A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word, as they were destined to do.

verses.rationale: Keeps four corporate titles and darkness/light movement.
verses.before: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
verses.after: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of the one who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for his possession, so that you may proclaim the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

verses.rationale: Preserves paired past/present reversals.
verses.before: Once you were not a people, but now you are God’s people; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
verses.after: Once you were not a people, but now you are God's people; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
verses.tsw_comparator: Once you were not a people, but now you are God’s people; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

verses.rationale: Keeps alien status and military image.
verses.before: Beloved, I urge you as sojourners and exiles to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which wage war against the soul.
verses.after: Beloved, I urge you as foreigners and temporary residents to abstain from fleshly desires that wage war against your life.
verses.tsw_comparator: Beloved, I urge you as sojourners and exiles to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which wage war against the soul.

verses.rationale: Retains accusation, visible acts and visitation.
verses.before: Keep your conduct among the nations honorable, so that when they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day of visitation.
verses.after: Maintain honorable conduct among the nations so that, where they accuse you as evildoers, they may observe your good works and glorify God on the day he visits.
verses.tsw_comparator: Keep your conduct among the nations honorable, so that when they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day of visitation.

verses.rationale: Keeps political submission and highest ruler.
verses.before: Be subject for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the emperor as supreme,
verses.after: For the Lord's sake, submit to every human institution, whether to the emperor as supreme
verses.tsw_comparator: Be subject for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the emperor as supreme,

verses.rationale: Preserves delegated punitive and commendatory roles.
verses.before: or to governors as sent by him to punish people who do wrong and to praise people who do right.
verses.after: or to governors sent by him to punish evildoers and praise those who do good.
verses.tsw_comparator: or to governors as sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.

verses.rationale: Keeps moral action as answer to accusation.
verses.before: For this is the will of God, that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish people.
verses.after: For this is God's will: by doing good, silence the ignorance of foolish people.
verses.tsw_comparator: For this is the will of God, that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish people.

verses.rationale: Preserves freedom/slavery paradox and concealment warning.
verses.before: Live as people who are free, not using your freedom as a cover for evil, but living as servants of God.
verses.after: Live as free people, but do not use freedom as a cover for evil; live as God's slaves.
verses.tsw_comparator: Live as people who are free, not using your freedom as a cover for evil, but living as servants of God.

verses.rationale: Keeps four concise commands and distinguishes fear from honor.
verses.before: Honor everyone. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the emperor.
verses.after: Honor everyone, love the family of believers, fear God and honor the emperor.
verses.tsw_comparator: Honor everyone. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the emperor.

verses.rationale: Names slavery, masters and unjust treatment directly.
verses.before: Servants, be subject to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle but also to the unjust.
verses.after: Household slaves, submit with full fear to your masters—not only to the good and gentle but also to the cruel.
verses.tsw_comparator: Servants, be subject to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle but also to the unjust.

verses.rationale: Retains suffering's injustice and Godward conscience.
verses.before: For this is a gracious thing, when mindful of God, one endures sorrows while suffering unjustly.
verses.after: For it is commendable if someone endures painful suffering unjustly because of consciousness of God.
verses.tsw_comparator: For this is a gracious thing, when mindful of God, one endures sorrows while suffering unjustly.

verses.rationale: Keeps physical abuse, ethical contrast and divine evaluation.
verses.before: For what credit is it if, when you sin and are beaten for it, you endure? But if when you do good and suffer for it you endure, this is a gracious thing in the sight of God.
verses.after: What credit is there if you endure beatings for sinning? But if you endure suffering for doing good, this is commendable before God.
verses.tsw_comparator: For what credit is it if, when you sin and are beaten for it, you endure? But if when you do good and suffer for it you endure, this is a gracious thing in the sight of God.

verses.rationale: Preserves call, representative suffering and footsteps.
verses.before: For to this you have been called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, so that you might follow in his steps.
verses.after: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example so that you might follow in his steps.
verses.tsw_comparator: For to this you have been called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, so that you might follow in his steps.

verses.rationale: Keeps twin innocence claims.
verses.before: He committed no sin, neither was deceit found in his mouth.
verses.after: He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in his mouth.
verses.tsw_comparator: He committed no sin, neither was deceit found in his mouth.

verses.rationale: Retains nonretaliation and divine judgment.
verses.before: When he was reviled, he did not revile in return; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but entrusted himself to the one who judges justly.
verses.after: When insulted, he did not insult in return; when suffering, he made no threats, but entrusted himself to the one who judges justly.
verses.tsw_comparator: When he was reviled, he did not revile in return; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but entrusted himself to the one who judges justly.

verses.rationale: Keeps body, execution tree, death/life and singular wound.
verses.before: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. By his wounds you have been healed.
verses.after: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that, having died to sins, we might live for righteousness. By his wound you were healed.
verses.tsw_comparator: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. By his wounds you have been healed.

verses.rationale: Retains animal image and both care titles.
verses.before: For you were straying like sheep, but have now returned to the shepherd and overseer of your souls.
verses.after: For you were straying like sheep, but now you have returned to the shepherd and overseer of your lives.
verses.tsw_comparator: For you were straying like sheep, but have now returned to the shepherd and overseer of your souls.

verses.rationale: Keeps gendered hierarchy and the hoped persuasion of unbelieving husbands.
verses.before: Likewise, wives, be subject to your own husbands, so that even if some do not obey the word, they may be won without a word by the conduct of their wives,
verses.after: In the same way, wives, submit to your own husbands so that even if some disobey the word, they may be won without a word by their wives' conduct
verses.tsw_comparator: Likewise, wives, be subject to your own husbands, so that even if some do not obey the word, they may be won without a word by the conduct of their wives,

verses.rationale: Preserves external observation and fear.
verses.before: when they see your pure conduct in reverent fear.
verses.after: when they observe your pure conduct marked by reverent fear.
verses.tsw_comparator: when they see your pure conduct in reverent fear.

verses.rationale: Keeps full status-display list while supplying merely to avoid forbidding clothing itself.
verses.before: Do not let your adorning be external—the braiding of hair and the putting on of gold jewelry or the clothing you wear—
verses.after: Do not let your adornment be merely external—braided hair, wearing gold or putting on fine clothes—
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not let your adorning be external—the braiding of hair and the putting on of gold jewelry or the clothing you wear—

verses.rationale: Retains inner self and divine valuation.
verses.before: but let it be the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which in God’s sight is of great worth.
verses.after: but let it be the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable quality of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious before God.
verses.tsw_comparator: but let it be the hidden person of the heart, with the imperishable beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which in God’s sight is of great worth.

verses.rationale: Keeps women as examples, hope and household submission.
verses.before: For in this way formerly the holy women who hoped in God adorned themselves, being subject to their own husbands,
verses.after: For this is how the holy women who hoped in God once adorned themselves, submitting to their own husbands,
verses.tsw_comparator: For in this way formerly the holy women who hoped in God adorned themselves, being subject to their own husbands,

verses.rationale: Retains both names, hierarchical address and freedom from intimidation.
verses.before: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord. And you have become her children if you do good and do not fear anything that is frightening.
verses.after: as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. You have become her daughters if you do good and do not fear any terror.
verses.tsw_comparator: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord. And you have become her children if you do good and do not fear anything that is frightening.

verses.rationale: Keeps gendered bodily comparison, equal inheritance and spiritual consequence.
verses.before: Likewise, husbands, live with your wives according to knowledge, showing honor to the woman as the weaker vessel, since they are also co-heirs of the grace of life, so that your prayers may not be hindered.
verses.after: Husbands, in the same way, live considerately with your wives, showing honor to the woman as the physically weaker partner and as a coheir of the grace of life, so that your prayers are not hindered.
verses.tsw_comparator: Likewise, husbands, live with your wives according to knowledge, showing honor to the woman as the weaker vessel, since they are also co-heirs of the grace of life, so that your prayers may not be hindered.

verses.rationale: Preserves all five communal qualities.
verses.before: Finally, all of you, be of one mind, sympathetic, loving one another, tenderhearted, humble,
verses.after: Finally, all of you, be harmonious, sympathetic, loving as family, compassionate and humble.
verses.tsw_comparator: Finally, all of you, be of one mind, sympathetic, loving one another, tenderhearted, humble,

verses.rationale: Keeps nonretaliation, opposite action and inheritance.
verses.before: not repaying evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary, blessing, because to this you were called, so that you may inherit a blessing.
verses.after: Do not repay evil for evil or insult for insult. Instead, bless, because you were called to this so that you may inherit blessing.
verses.tsw_comparator: not repaying evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary, blessing, because to this you were called, so that you may inherit a blessing.

verses.rationale: Retains bodily speech organs and conditional desire.
verses.before: For, “Whoever desires to love life and to see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit;
verses.after: For “the one who wants to love life and see good days must keep the tongue from evil and the lips from speaking deceit;
verses.tsw_comparator: For, “Whoever desires to love life and to see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit;

verses.rationale: Keeps four active commands.
verses.before: let him turn away from evil and do good; let him seek peace and pursue it.
verses.after: turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
verses.tsw_comparator: let him turn away from evil and do good; let him seek peace and pursue it.

verses.rationale: Preserves anthropomorphic eyes, ears and opposed face.
verses.before: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
verses.after: For the Lord's eyes are on the righteous and his ears attend to their prayer, but the Lord's face is against those who do evil.”
verses.tsw_comparator: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

verses.rationale: Keeps rhetorical expectation rather than an absolute guarantee.
verses.before: Now who is there to harm you if you are zealous for what is good?
verses.after: Who will harm you if you become eager for what is good?
verses.tsw_comparator: Now who is there to harm you if you are zealous for what is good?

verses.rationale: Preserves real possibility of unjust suffering and quoted command.
verses.before: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. Do not fear what they fear, nor be troubled,
verses.after: But even if you should suffer for righteousness, you are blessed. Do not fear what they fear or be troubled,
verses.tsw_comparator: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. Do not fear what they fear, nor be troubled,

verses.rationale: Keeps inward consecration and universal readiness.
verses.before: but in your hearts regard Christ as holy as Lord, always being ready to give a defense to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you;
verses.after: but honor Christ as Lord in your hearts. Always be ready to give a defense to anyone who asks you for the reason for the hope within you,
verses.tsw_comparator: but in your hearts regard Christ as holy as Lord, always being ready to give a defense to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you;

verses.rationale: Preserves manner, conscience and verbal harm.
verses.before: yet do it with gentleness and reverent fear, having a good conscience, so that when you are slandered, people who revile your good conduct in Christ may be put to shame.
verses.after: yet do so with gentleness and reverent fear, maintaining a good conscience, so that those who slander your good conduct in Christ may be put to shame for their abuse.
verses.tsw_comparator: yet do it with gentleness and reverent fear, having a good conscience, so that when you are slandered, those who revile your good conduct in Christ may be put to shame.

verses.rationale: Keeps comparative claim and divine-will qualification.
verses.before: For it is better to suffer for doing good, if that should be God’s will, than for doing evil.
verses.after: For it is better to suffer for doing good, if that should be God's will, than for doing evil.
verses.tsw_comparator: For it is better to suffer for doing good, if that should be God’s will, than for doing evil.

verses.rationale: Retains once-for-all suffering, substitution and flesh/spirit contrast.
verses.before: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, having been put to death in the flesh but made alive in the spirit,
verses.after: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous one for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in flesh but made alive in spirit,
verses.tsw_comparator: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, having been put to death in the flesh but made alive in the spirit,

verses.rationale: Keeps movement, proclamation and imprisoned spirits without identifying them.
verses.before: in which also he went and proclaimed to the spirits in prison,
verses.after: in which he also went and proclaimed to the spirits in prison,
verses.tsw_comparator: in which also he went and proclaimed to the spirits in prison,

verses.rationale: Preserves Noah, ark, exact number and water rescue.
verses.before: who formerly did not obey, when God’s patience waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was being prepared, in which a few—that is, eight souls—were brought safely through water.
verses.after: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in Noah's days while the ark was being built. In it a few—that is, eight people—were brought safely through water.
verses.tsw_comparator: who formerly did not obey, when God’s patience waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was being prepared, in which a few—that is, eight souls—were brought safely through water.

verses.rationale: Keeps salvation claim, denies mere washing and retains conscience ambiguity as appeal.
verses.before: Corresponding to this, baptism now saves you—not as a removal of dirt from the body but as an appeal of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
verses.after: Baptism, which corresponds to this, now saves you—not as removal of dirt from the body, but as an appeal to God for a good conscience—through Jesus Christ's resurrection.
verses.tsw_comparator: Corresponding to this, baptism now saves you—not as a removal of dirt from the body but as an appeal of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

verses.rationale: Preserves ascension, enthronement and three subordinated groups.
verses.before: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, with angels and authorities and powers having been subjected to him.
verses.after: He has gone into heaven and is at God's right hand, with angels, authorities and powers subjected to him.
verses.tsw_comparator: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, with angels and authorities and powers having been subjected to him.

verses.rationale: Keeps military preparation and the difficult suffering/sin claim.
verses.before: So, since Christ suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same purpose—for whoever has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
verses.after: Therefore, since Christ suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves with the same intention, because whoever suffers in the flesh has ceased from sin,
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore, since Christ suffered in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same purpose—for whoever has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

verses.rationale: Retains embodied remaining life and opposed aims.
verses.before: so as to live the rest of your time in the flesh no longer for human passions but for the will of God.
verses.after: so as to live the remaining time in the flesh no longer for human desires but for God's will.
verses.tsw_comparator: so as to live the rest of your time in the flesh no longer for human passions but for the will of God.

verses.rationale: Keeps the full vice list and polemical ethnic framing.
verses.before: For the time that has passed is enough for doing what the Gentiles want to do—living in sensuality, passions, drunkenness, wild parties, drinking bouts, and lawless idolatry.
verses.after: For enough time has passed to carry out the desire of the nations, living in debauchery, lusts, drunkenness, orgies, drinking parties and forbidden idolatries.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the time that has passed is enough for doing what the Gentiles want to do—living in sensuality, passions, drunkenness, wild parties, drinking bouts, and lawless idolatry.

verses.rationale: Retains running/flood imagery and verbal abuse.
verses.before: They are surprised that you do not run with them into the same flood of reckless living, and they speak evil of you.
verses.after: They are surprised that you no longer run with them into the same flood of reckless living, and they slander you.
verses.tsw_comparator: They are surprised that you do not run with them into the same flood of reckless living, and they speak evil of you.

verses.rationale: Keeps accountability and universal judgment.
verses.before: But they will give account to the one who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
verses.after: They will give an account to the one ready to judge the living and the dead.
verses.tsw_comparator: But they will give account to the one who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

verses.rationale: Preserves proclamation to the dead and flesh/spirit outcome without resolving timing.
verses.before: For this reason the good news was proclaimed even to the dead, so that though they were judged in the flesh as mortals, they might live in the spirit as God does.
verses.after: For this is why the good news was proclaimed even to the dead: so that though judged in the flesh according to human standards, they might live in the spirit according to God.
verses.tsw_comparator: For this reason the good news was proclaimed even to the dead, so that though they were judged in the flesh as mortals, they might live in the spirit as God does.

verses.rationale: Keeps eschatological nearness and two prayer disciplines.
verses.before: The end of everything has drawn near. Therefore be clear-minded and self-controlled for prayers.
verses.after: The end of all things has drawn near. Therefore, be self-controlled and sober for prayer.
verses.tsw_comparator: The end of all things has drawn near. Therefore be clear-minded and self-controlled for prayers.

verses.rationale: Preserves priority, intensity and covering image.
verses.before: Above all, keep loving one another earnestly, because love covers a multitude of sins.
verses.after: Above all, maintain earnest love for one another, because love covers a multitude of sins.
verses.tsw_comparator: Above all, keep loving one another earnestly, because love covers a multitude of sins.

verses.rationale: Keeps mutual stranger-welcome and complaint restraint.
verses.before: Show hospitality to one another without grumbling.
verses.after: Offer hospitality to one another without grumbling.
verses.tsw_comparator: Show hospitality to one another without grumbling.

verses.rationale: Retains universal gifting, mutual service and stewardship.
verses.before: As each has received a gift, use it to serve one another as good stewards of God’s varied grace.
verses.after: As each person has received a gift, use it to serve one another as good stewards of God's varied grace.
verses.tsw_comparator: As each has received a gift, use it to serve one another as good stewards of God’s varied grace.

verses.rationale: Keeps two gift categories, divine supply and doxology.
verses.before: Whoever speaks should do so as one who speaks the words of God; whoever serves should do so from the strength God supplies, so that in everything God may be glorified through Jesus Christ. To him belong glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.after: If anyone speaks, let it be as God's words; if anyone serves, let it be from the strength God supplies, so that God may be glorified in everything through Jesus Christ. To him belong glory and power forever and ever. Amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever speaks should do so as one who speaks the words of God; whoever serves should do so from the strength God supplies, so that in everything God may be glorified through Jesus Christ. To him belong glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.

verses.rationale: Retains fire and testing without minimizing trauma.
verses.before: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal among you that is coming upon you to test you, as if something strange were happening to you.
verses.after: Beloved, do not be surprised by the fiery ordeal among you that tests you, as though something strange were happening to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery ordeal among you that is coming upon you to test you, as though something strange were happening to you.

verses.rationale: Keeps measured sharing and future joy.
verses.before: But rejoice insofar as you share in Christ’s sufferings, so that you may also rejoice and be glad when his glory is revealed.
verses.after: Instead, rejoice insofar as you share Christ's sufferings, so that you may also rejoice exuberantly when his glory is revealed.
verses.tsw_comparator: But rejoice insofar as you share in Christ’s sufferings, so that you may also rejoice and be glad when his glory is revealed.

verses.rationale: Preserves verbal abuse, blessing and Spirit's rest.
verses.before: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory, the Spirit of God, rests on you.
verses.after: If you are insulted because of Christ's name, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
verses.tsw_comparator: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory, the Spirit of God, rests on you.

verses.rationale: Keeps all four causes, including murder.
verses.before: But let none of you suffer as a murderer or a thief or a wrongdoer or as a meddler.
verses.after: Let none of you suffer as a murderer, thief, evildoer or meddler in another's affairs.
verses.tsw_comparator: But let none of you suffer as a murderer or a thief or a wrongdoer or as a meddler.

verses.rationale: Retains early identity label, shame and honor response.
verses.before: Yet if someone suffers as a Christian, let them not be ashamed, but let them glorify God in that name.
verses.after: But if anyone suffers as a Christian, let that person not be ashamed but glorify God in this name.
verses.tsw_comparator: Yet if anyone suffers as a Christian, let them not be ashamed, but let them glorify God in that name.

verses.rationale: Keeps judgment's starting place and rhetorical escalation.
verses.before: For it is time for judgment to begin at the house of God; and if it begins with us first, what will the outcome be for people who do not obey the good news of God?
verses.after: For it is time for judgment to begin with God's household; and if it begins with us, what will be the outcome for those who disobey God's good news?
verses.tsw_comparator: For it is time for judgment to begin at the house of God; and if it begins with us first, what will the outcome be for those who do not obey the good news of God?

verses.rationale: Preserves quoted difficulty and unresolved rhetorical fate.
verses.before: And if “the righteous are scarcely saved,” where will the ungodly and the sinner appear?
verses.after: And “if the righteous person is saved with difficulty, what will become of the ungodly and sinner?”
verses.tsw_comparator: And if “the righteous are scarcely saved,” where will the ungodly and the sinner appear?

verses.rationale: Keeps suffering, divine will and active good rather than passive harm acceptance.
verses.before: So let people who suffer according to God’s will entrust their lives to a faithful Creator while doing good.
verses.after: Therefore, let those who suffer according to God's will entrust their lives to a faithful Creator while doing good.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore let those who suffer according to God’s will entrust their lives to a faithful Creator while doing good.

verses.rationale: Keeps threefold self-identification and future glory.
verses.before: So I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, as well as a sharer in the glory that is going to be revealed:
verses.after: Therefore, I urge the elders among you, as a fellow elder, a witness of Christ's sufferings and a partner in the glory about to be revealed:
verses.tsw_comparator: So I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, as well as a sharer in the glory that is going to be revealed:

verses.rationale: Preserves shepherding, oversight and both motive contrasts.
verses.before: shepherd the flock of God that is among you, exercising oversight, not under compulsion, but willingly, as God would have you; not for shameful gain, but eagerly;
verses.after: Shepherd God's flock among you, exercising oversight not under compulsion but willingly, according to God; not for shameful gain but eagerly;
verses.tsw_comparator: shepherd the flock of God that is among you, exercising oversight, not under compulsion, but willingly, as God would have you; not for shameful gain, but eagerly;

verses.rationale: Keeps prohibition of domination and exemplary alternative.
verses.before: not domineering over those in your charge, but being examples to the flock.
verses.after: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but becoming examples to the flock.
verses.tsw_comparator: not domineering over those in your charge, but being examples to the flock.

verses.rationale: Retains pastoral title, appearance and crown.
verses.before: And when the chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.
verses.after: And when the chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: And when the chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.

verses.rationale: Keeps age relation, clothing image and quoted reversal.
verses.before: Likewise, you who are younger, be subject to the elders. Clothe yourselves, all of you, with humility toward one another, for “God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.”
verses.after: Likewise, younger people, submit to the elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because “God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Likewise, you who are younger, be subject to the elders. Clothe yourselves, all of you, with humility toward one another, for “God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.”

verses.rationale: Preserves hand image, humility and future raising.
verses.before: Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God so that at the proper time he may exalt you,
verses.after: Therefore, humble yourselves under God's mighty hand, so that he may exalt you at the proper time,
verses.tsw_comparator: Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God so that at the proper time he may exalt you,

verses.rationale: Keeps burden transfer and divine concern.
verses.before: casting all your anxieties on him, because he cares for you.
verses.after: casting all your anxiety on him, because he cares for you.
verses.tsw_comparator: casting all your anxieties on him, because he cares for you.

verses.rationale: Retains legal opponent, animal simile and violent threat.
verses.before: Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
verses.after: Be sober and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
verses.tsw_comparator: Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

verses.rationale: Keeps resistance, stability and global solidarity.
verses.before: Resist him, firm in your trust, knowing that the same kinds of suffering are being experienced by your brotherhood throughout the world.
verses.after: Resist him, firm in the faith, knowing that the same sufferings are being endured by your family of believers throughout the world.
verses.tsw_comparator: Resist him, firm in your faith, knowing that the same kinds of suffering are being experienced by your brotherhood throughout the world.

verses.rationale: Retains suffering duration, call and four divine actions.
verses.before: And after you have suffered a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to his eternal glory in Christ, will himself restore, confirm, strengthen, and establish you.
verses.after: After you have suffered a little while, the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, will himself restore, establish, strengthen and ground you.
verses.tsw_comparator: And after you have suffered a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to his eternal glory in Christ, will himself restore, confirm, strengthen, and establish you.

verses.rationale: Preserves concise doxology.
verses.before: To him be the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
verses.after: To him be power forever and ever. Amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: To him be the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

verses.rationale: Keeps messenger, personal assessment and two purposes.
verses.before: By Silvanus, a faithful brother as I regard him, I have written briefly to you, exhorting and declaring that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
verses.after: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is God's true grace. Stand firm in it.
verses.tsw_comparator: By Silvanus, a faithful brother as I regard him, I have written briefly to you, exhorting and declaring that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.

verses.rationale: Retains feminine coded sender, Babylon and named Mark.
verses.before: She who is in Babylon, who is likewise chosen, sends you greetings, and so does Mark, my son.
verses.after: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you, and so does my son Mark.
verses.tsw_comparator: She who is in Babylon, who is likewise chosen, sends you greetings, and so does Mark, my son.

verses.rationale: Keeps embodied greeting and inclusive peace.
verses.before: Greet one another with the kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
verses.after: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: Greet one another with the kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
